description: For a merchant-ops or analytics agent: list active drift alerts, the recommendation rules whose confidence has materially changed (weakened, strengthened, disappeared, emerged) versus the prior mining job. Use this when a merchant asks 'what's changed?', 'is my model still accurate?', 'are any rules drifting?', or wants to investigate a SKU swap / seasonal shift. Merchant-ops surface: BigCommerce today; on other platforms merchants manage this from the admin, and the tool returns a clear not-available message.

limit.description: Max alerts to return. Default 10, max 50.

name: get_drift_alerts
